mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 76 degrees under a New Moon at Harriet Park, with an overnight low of 62 and no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote, which will serve as our long-range guide for infrastructure, housing, and sustainable growth over the next decade.
We have a full slate of activity, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a busy day tomorrow featuring Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee.
In a notable weekly report from September 28, officers handled a motor vehicle crash involving a 16-year-old operating an eMoto in a reckless manner, resulting in several citations.
The Culver's of Verona is now closed for the evening after serving up Georgia Peach, but you can look forward to tomorrow's flavor, OREO Cookie Cheesecake, when the restaurant opens at 10 AM.
